Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement would like a clearer mapping of how Redwood shows EU data residency / sovereignty charges on the invoice. Two quick questions so we can move to terms:

1) If we choose hosted API with EU residency, does Redwood charge a single bundled premium or separate line items (base usage + geo delta + residency adder)? We need itemized lines for our AP team.

2) Are residency adders applied only when data-at-rest is kept in EU regions, or also when logs/analytics are retained outside the EU? Acme's legal needs to know how logs are handled and whether that affects cost.

Can you attach a sample invoice or CSV with line codes? That will speed procurement sign-off.

Best,
Laura Benson

Acme Corp

From: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification on EU-specific line items and invoicing

Hi Laura —

Thanks — quick answers below and attaching a sample invoice CSV. Short summary first, full details after.

Summary:
- We support both itemized and bundled billing.
- Itemized: base hosted rate + EU regional delta + sovereignty adders (data-at-rest, log retention).
- Bundled: single higher base rate that covers EU hosting + standard log retention; good for simpler procurement.

Details / invoice mapping (attached file: invoice_sample_eu_tagging.xlsx)
- LINE-BS: BASE_HOSTED_USD — Base token rate (per 1M tokens) billed in your invoice currency.
- LINE-GEO-EU: REGION_DELTA_EU — Per-1M delta for routing to EU region (applies when request is routed to EU endpoints).
- LINE-SOV-ATREST: SOV_AT_REST — One-time monthly adder for encrypted EU-at-rest storage and KMS controls (if you opt for EU-only persistence).
- LINE-SOV-LOG: SOV_LOG_RETENTION — Monthly adder if you require EU-resident logs/analytics; otherwise logs default to aggregated, redacted events and are retained per the standard policy.

How it works operationally:
- If you select EU-hosted endpoints but do not enable EU-resident logs, only REGION_DELTA_EU applies.
- If you also opt into EU-at-rest and EU log retention, both SOV_* adders appear as separate lines.

Options we typically propose for enterprise customers:
1) Itemized (recommended for visibility): Base + Region Delta + optional SOV adders.
2) Inclusive plan (useful for centralized procurement): single consolidated rate (we fold estimated adders into base).

Let us know which format your AP team prefers. Attaching: redwood_ratecard_v3.pdf and invoice_sample_eu_tagging.xlsx.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification on EU-specific line items and invoicing

Hi Laura —

Quick reply on the two asks from finance/legal plus a commercial proposal to speed things up.

1) Logs and residency: we can offer EU-resident log storage (SOV_LOG_RETENTION) — logs will be written to EU-only buckets with customer-owned KMS. That feature triggers the separate LINE-SOV-LOG adder. If you opt for standard opt-out (redacted events), no extra log line appears. I can loop Jonas from our cloud partner if you want a short tech note.

2) Commitment pricing (list per 1M tokens, USD, before discounts):
- 250M/mo: Base $4.80 / 1M tokens; REGION_DELTA_EU +$0.60 / 1M; SOV_AT_REST monthly adder $1,000; SOV_LOG_RETENTION monthly adder $1,500.
- 1B/mo: Base $3.90 / 1M tokens; REGION_DELTA_EU +$0.55 / 1M; SOV_AT_REST $900/mo; SOV_LOG_RETENTION $1,200/mo.
- 3B/mo: Base $3.20 / 1M tokens; REGION_DELTA_EU +$0.45 / 1M; SOV_AT_REST $600/mo; SOV_LOG_RETENTION $900/mo.

Committed discount structure (applies to token-based line items only):
- 0% for pay-as-you-go
- 7% at >=250M/month commit
- 14% at >=1B/month commit
- 20% at >=3B/month commit

Note: discounts applied to BASE and REGION_DELTA lines; SOV adders are fixed monthly fees and are eligible for a one-time volume credit during onboarding (we can offer a migration credit to offset the first month of SOV adders).

3) Invoice line mapping: yes — we can include your contract code in the CSV mapping (we'll populate a ContractCode field in invoice_sample_eu_tagging.xlsx).

Commercial proposal to close quickly:
- If Acme signs a 12-month committed contract at >=1B/mo, Redwood can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $12,000 toward the first two months of SOV adders and a 10% introductory uplift on the committed discount for the first quarter.

Next steps:
- Monica/Stephanie: can you provide the preferred invoice format and Acme internal contract code?
- Laura: confirm if you want EU-resident logs enabled for the trial.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
